name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-06-30.145.8): > *That so much of the standing orders be suspended as would prevent the motion being moved immediately and determined without amendment or debate.* This means that Tasmanian Senator Nick McKim (Greens) can now introduce [his motion](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/senate/2026-06-30/19). #### Rebellion South Australian Senator [Alex Antic](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/alex_antic) rebelled against the rest of his party and voted "no" while the rest of the Liberal Party voted "yes".
